name: North Carolina

context: NC 340: Cover crop reduces sheet, rill and wind erosion; time establishment to protect soil in critical erosion periods.
NC 603: Herbaceous wind barriers are narrow strips of herbaceous plants in the field that cut wind speed and erosion.
cover_rules: NC 340: Aim for a minimum of 90-percent combined canopy and residue cover during the period of potentially erosive wind or rainfall.
NC 340: Use current erosion prediction technology to set how much surface and canopy cover the cover crop must give.
residue: NC 329: Use approved wind erosion prediction technology to set the residue amount, timing and allowed soil disturbance.
NC 329: Distribute all residues uniformly over the entire field. Do not burn residue.
seeding: NC 342: Common or hybrid bermudagrass: D5-7 lbs, B6-8 lbs (drill, broadcast), seeded 1/4-1/2 inch deep.
NC 342: Weeping lovegrass 4-6 lbs gives quick summer cover and suits droughty sites.
pasture: NC 512: Minimize soil disturbance with seedbed methods such as chemical burn-down and no-till drilling of forages.
disturbed: NC 342: Prairie cordgrass 7-8 lbs drilled or 8-9 lbs broadcast PLS/ac suits dry detention structures that hold water no more than 30 days.
NC 342: Tall fescue and white clover 30-50 lbs suits areas where regular mowing and high maintenance are provided.

coverPlant.text: NC 340: Cereal rye, oats, wheat, barley, triticale and ryegrass: Coastal Plain Sept 1 - Nov 15; Piedmont Aug 25 - Nov 1; Mountains Jul 25-Oct 15.
NC 340: Pearl millet and proso millet: Coastal Plain May 1 - June 15; Piedmont May 1 - July 1; Mountains May 15 - July 1.

seedWin.text: NC 342: Weeping lovegrass 4-6 lbs: Mountains May 1 - June 15 best; Piedmont April 15 - June 1 best; third zone April 1 - May 15 best.
NC 342: Tall fescue 30-40 lbs: Piedmont Aug 25 - Sept 15; third zone Sept 1 - Sept 30; Mountains July 25 - Aug 10 or March 20 - April 20.

gaps: Windbreak species: NC 380 gives design rules but no species list in the files read.
Barrier species and rates (NC 603): not found.
MLRA seeding zones: documents use Coastal Plain, Piedmont and Mountains only.
Native species rates and sandy/loamy soil lists: only prairie cordgrass found.
